note: Alarm definitions copied verbatim from PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2015 Table 1 (checked 2026-11-22). Suppression thresholds below are engineering defaults, NOT clinical rules, until Dr Zayed signs.

Asystole.definition: No QRS for at least 4 seconds

Bradycardia.definition: Heart rate lower than 40 bpm for 5 consecutive beats

Tachycardia.definition: Heart rate higher than 140 bpm for 17 consecutive beats

Ventricular_Tachycardia.definition: 5 or more ventricular beats with heart rate higher than 100 bpm

Ventricular_Flutter_Fib.definition: Fibrillatory, flutter, or oscillatory waveform for at least 4 seconds

suppression.rule: Suppress (route to quiet review, never discard) only when a high-quality pulsatile channel (ABP or PPG) contradicts the alarm for the whole window before the alarm.
